name: bigcode_bench_debug
description: A small debugging benchmark of code-level problems intended to evaluate models' ability to identify and fix bugs in code. It contains code snippets and associated debugging tasks where models must produce corrected code or identify the fault. Performance is measured by whether the proposed fix satisfies the expected behavior (e.g., passes tests) or matches the reference fix.
reputation: Small experimental benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in code-debugging research.
